headers.//: Everything under /static is content-hashed by Vite (index-<hash>.js, mods-<hash>.json), so a given URL's bytes can never change. Cache it permanently: a repeat visitor re-downloads none of the 3.1 MB data file.
index.html is NOT hashed -- it is how a new deploy is discovered, so it must be revalidated every time. must-revalidate with max-age=0 lets the browser keep a copy but forces a conditional request.
